description: Polymer micro element definition with core Polymer framework setup, including custom element registration, rendering status management, and attribute/property synchronization.

classes.name: Polymer
classes.description: Main namespace object for Polymer framework, including settings, telemetry, rendering, import status, and base class functionalities.

classes.name: Polymer.Base
classes.description: Base class providing core features for Polymer elements, including lifecycle callbacks, property management, behaviors, and attribute/property synchronization.

classes.name: Polymer.RenderStatus
classes.description: Manages rendering lifecycle, including when the framework is ready and after-next-render callbacks.

classes.name: Polymer.ImportStatus
classes.description: Alias for RenderStatus, indicating import loading status.

classes.name: Polymer.Class
classes.description: Desugared class factory for creating Polymer elements.

classes.name: Polymer.CaseMap
classes.description: Utility for converting between camelCase and dash-case.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Initializes Polymer settings based on URL parameters and feature detection.

methods.name: telemetry._registrate
methods.description: Registers a Polymer prototype for telemetry tracking.

methods.name: RenderStatus.whenReady
methods.description: Registers a callback to be called when Polymer is ready.

methods.name: RenderStatus._makeReady
methods.description: Marks Polymer as ready and executes queued callbacks.

methods.name: RenderStatus.afterNextRender
methods.description: Schedules a callback to run after the next render cycle.

methods.name: _registerFeatures
methods.description: Prepares element features like is, behaviors, constructor, and property info.

methods.name: _prepIs
methods.description: Prepares the element's is property based on the parent node or module.

methods.name: _desugarSomeBehaviors
methods.description: Processes behaviors into a flattened list.

methods.name: _marshalBehavior
methods.description: Marshals individual behaviors into the element.

methods.name: _addHostAttributes
methods.description: Adds host attributes to the element.

methods.name: _marshalHostAttributes
methods.description: Applies host attributes to the element.

methods.name: _takeAttributesToModel
methods.description: Copies attributes from DOM to properties.

methods.name: _setAttributeToProperty
methods.description: Sets a property based on an attribute value.

methods.name: serializeValueToAttribute
methods.description: Serializes a property value to an attribute.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts attribute string values to property types.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts property values to attribute string.
